MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of
March 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Acme Corp, a
Delaware corporation ("Client"), and Northwind Traders LLC, a
California limited liability company ("Provider").
1. Term. This Agreement shall remain in effect until February 28,
2027 (the "Termination Date"), unless earlier terminated as
provided herein.
2. Fees. Client shall pay Provider a monthly fee of $5,000.00,
due on the first business day of each month.

3. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep confidential all
non-public information disclosed by the other party and shall
not use such information except to perform its obligations
under this Agreement.
4. Obligations. Provider shall deliver monthly status reports
and Client shall provide timely access to information reasonably
required for Provider to perform the services.
5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the
State of Delaware.
